title: Is the 401(k) Max Contribution Myth Keeping You From Wealth?

scenes.text: Maxing your 401(k) at $22,500 might not be the smartest move for everyone.
Everyone should contribute the maximum to a 401(k) to build wealth.
scenes.label: Max 401k = Wealth

scenes.text: For high‑income earners, investing beyond the 401(k) in a Roth IRA or taxable brokerage can offer higher tax‑free growth and flexibility.
scenes.label: Beyond 401k needed

scenes.text: Diversify beyond the 401(k) for better long‑term returns.
scenes.label: Diversify now
